description: This file defines the 'Middleware' class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, containing static methods to create various HTTP client middleware components, such as handling cookies, HTTP errors, request history, redirects, retries, logging, preparing request bodies, and request/response mapping.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to generate various middleware functions for handling HTTP requests and responses in GuzzleHttp client.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds cookies to outgoing requests, utilizing a CookieJarInterface provided via options.

methods.name: httpErrors
methods.description: Creates middleware that throws exceptions for 4xx and 5xx responses when 'http_errors' option is true.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware that records request and response data into a provided container, which can be an array or implement ArrayAccess.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware that invokes provided callback functions before and after sending a request, without modifying the request or response.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates middleware that manages HTTP redirects.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware that retries requests based on a decision function and optional delay.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Creates middleware that logs request and response data using a specified logger and formatter.

methods.name: prepareBody
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds default headers related to request body content.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to requests before sending.

methods.name: mapResponse
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to responses after receiving.
